items.title: Formalize Trend Evolution Fact Family
items.scope: Formalize the threshold-free direction, efficiency, velocity and rolling-range-position facts justified by the third-group profile without opening Stage propositions or new market-data reads.
acceptance: A/B freeze semantics and implementation before qualification
C reproduces the fact family from two accepted immutable cold-source artifacts with no DWD/provider access
D binds only accepted runtime concepts and closes all implementation/qualification authority
No Stage projection, parameter search, LabelCard, holdout, daily, strategy or trading authority opens

items.title: Freeze Trend Evolution Fact Family semantics
items.scope: Freeze the seven concept meanings/windows, same-coordinate contiguous-history rules and the math-only velocity-delta boundary.
acceptance: Fact family has a stable Chinese/English business name
Positive velocity delta is not intrinsically called acceleration
Rolling extrema are not confirmed tops/bottoms
Range-width/center and activity stay outside this fact family
Stage thresholds and usage clocks stay outside Fact identity

items.title: Implement Trend Evolution Facts, deep verifier and fixed Worker route
items.scope: Implement typed Trend Evolution observations, reset/availability semantics, immutable-source A/B qualification and a fixed Event Worker dispatch path.
acceptance: Formal calculations exactly match frozen third-group morphology formulas
Reset, zero-range, prefix-replay and no-stage counterexamples pass
Deep verifier first validates each original F9 source artifact
Worker admits only the fixed Trend Evolution qualification config
Qualification code has no market-data/provider opening path

items.title: Qualify Trend Evolution Facts from two immutable cold-source artifacts
items.scope: Execute one governed qualification Job that replays only the two accepted F9 source artifacts and requires byte-identical Trend Evolution facts and deterministic review samples.
acceptance: Both source F9 artifacts pass original deep verification
Source-input payloads and reconstructed Trend Evolution fact payloads match exactly across A/B
Fact counts and deterministic review sample are durably bound
Market-data read and DWD-provider-open counters remain zero
No Stage projection/search/LabelCard output is emitted

items.title: Freeze accepted Trend Evolution runtime bindings
items.scope: After C passes, bind only the accepted Trend Evolution concepts in the Structure blueprint/Catalog and close the milestone without opening Stage 1/12 or 8/9 search.
acceptance: Blueprint binds only the seven qualified concepts
Accepted B1-B5 and Support Evolution identities remain unchanged
Trend Evolution becomes the reusable substrate for later Stage 1/12 and high-side modifier research
Structure Order remains the next separately gated fact-family milestone
All implementation/qualification authority closes after acceptance
